instruction: A cinematic fashion portrait photograph in a medium shot at eye-level, set in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the red-haired woman in the beige striped blazer (R1) stands facing forward, her eyes closed and her head tilted to the right, resting gently against the cheek of the blonde woman in the dark grey blazer (R2). The blonde woman (R2) stands facing forward, looking directly at the camera with a serious, neutral expression, while holding the red-haired woman's (R1) arm with her left hand. Harsh, direct sunlight streams from the upper left, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the subjects and the background wall, creating a warm, muted color palette.
